Confirmed by direct grep that SPEC-06's five-constraints-plus-nullability disclosure and ADV-L01-03's retention sentence are both stated in packages/db/README.md. One rig-state item (ADV-L01-09) was independently re-run and reproduces exactly as disclosed (x41-round35-tie.test.mjs's x41.s4 fails alone on clara_l01, pass 2 / fail 1) -- this is the reviewer's own leftover fixture state, explicitly carried to the integrator rather than claimed fixed, and is neither newly broken nor silently dropped.
